text: Established contact via email with Franklin Service regarding an alleged medical debt I owed on XX/XX/XXXX with XXXX XXXX in the amount of {$250.00}. A proof/outline of the debt was requested and a printout was sent to verify I was in communication with the right company that matched the letter they sent. On the same day, I requested an itemization of the debt from XXXX in order to verify the debt was real. I followed up further with XXXX on XX/XX/XXXX as an itemization of the debt had still not been provided. XXXX then sent a response confirming that an itemized statement will be sent. After no contact or response providing the requested itemization of the debt from Franklin Service, I received a phone call on XX/XX/XXXX harassing me for the debt again. I then requested the same debt itemization breakdown over the phone and they confirmed they would work on sending it to me as I couldn't pay the debt without validation. As of XX/XX/XXXX I received a response from XXXX at Franklin Service stating that they are still working on getting an itemized statement. It has still not be provided to me. Per 1006.34 Notice for validation of debts, the five day window for providing me with this itemized debt information has now passed given that it is now XX/XX/XXXX. Please see attached email messages regarding communication.
